body:
## What it is

WeGoTrip sells this as a self-guided audio tour in Paris, France. The listing gives its length as 2 hours, over a route of about 8 km. It starts at Musée Banksy - The World Of Banksy - Paris, Rue du Faubourg Montmartre, 44. An entry ticket is part of the package; the listing includes: Entrance ticket to The World Of Banksy Expo Paris. The tour plays in the WeGoTrip app on your own phone. WeGoTrip names Kseniya as the tour's author.

## How WeGoTrip describes it

> This self-guided audio tour is designed for anyone interested in exploring the rich history, stunning architecture, and vibrant cultural scene of Paris. Whether you're a history buff, an art enthusiast, or simply a curious traveler, this tour will guide you through some of the most iconic and historically significant sites in Paris.
>
> The tour begins at 'The World Of Banksy Expo,' where you'll delve into the enigmatic world of street art and the works of the anonymous artist Banksy. From there, you'll make your way to landmarks such as the grand Palais Garnier, the elegant Place Vendôme, the historic Arc de Triomphe du Carrousel, the Louvre Museum, and the Conciergerie, among others.
>
> Along the way, you'll experience the medieval grandeur of the Conciergerie, the stunning stained-glass windows of Sainte-Chapelle, and the architectural beauty of the Pont Alexandre III. You'll also explore the Musée d'Orsay, housed in a former train station, and stroll through the charming Rue Cler, known for its high-quality specialty shops and traditional Parisian life. The most memorable experiences will include the grandeur of the Eiffel Tower, the historical significance of the Hôtel des Invalides, and the picturesque views of the Seine from the Pont des Arts.
>
> Although entry ticket to The World of Banksy Expo is included, please be aware that there is no guided tour. You are invited to explore the exhibit at your leisure.
